title: The Asset cell is two lines (bold unit number over a muted VIN), with placeholders when either is missing, and VIN is also its own optional column
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The report shows work orders including: one whose asset has both a unit number and a vehicle identification number, one with no unit number, and one with no vehicle identification number.
custom_steps:
1. Read the Asset cell of a row whose asset has both values.
2. Read the Asset cell of the row with no unit number, then the one with no vehicle identification number.
3. Open the column-selection control, turn on the VIN column, and read it.
custom_expected:
1. The Asset cell is two lines: the unit number on the first line in bold, and the vehicle identification number on the second line in a smaller, muted style.
2. When a work order has no unit number, the first line shows "(no unit #)"; when it has no vehicle identification number, the second line shows "— no VIN —".
3. The VIN column (off by default) shows the vehicle identification number on its own line as a separate, sortable column.
